description: American Depositary Receipt details for a foreign issuer: how many ordinary shares one American Depositary Share represents (the ADR ratio, e.g. 5 for TSMC), the basis on which per-share figures are published (per ADS, in US dollars), the ratio recorded on each period, and which share counts stay in ordinary shares. For a company with no ADR program it says so: its per-share figures are per ordinary share as filed.

record.description: An earlier published record, by tag ('FY27Q1') or by the period its filing reports ('Q1 FY2027'). Omit for the latest. list_periods lists every record.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.

name: get_adr_details
title: ADR / ADS ratio
